Public Safety Commission Meeting - Audio Only
Public Comment from the Audience
•
If you wish to address the Public Safety Commission, please complete a Speaker Request Card, as it must be handed to the Recording Secretary before the start of the meeting.
•
The Public Safety Commission will hear public comments on matters not listed on the agenda during the Public Comments from the Audience period.
•
Opportunity to address the Public Safety Commission (on non-agenda items) is limited to 3 minutes per speaker.
•
The Public Safety Commission will hear public comments on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote.
Brown Act
Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Public Safety Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future Public Safety Commission meeting.
Rules of Decorum
Persons attending the meeting shall observe rules of propriety, decorum, good conduct, and refrain from impertinent or slanderous remarks. Violation of this rule shall result in such persons being barred from further audience before the governing body. Pursuant to Gov. Code Sect. 54954.3(c), any person who engages in unlawful interference shall be removed from chambers.
Americans with Disabilities Act
In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk's office at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to allow the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to the meeting or service.
This agenda was posted 72 hours in advance of the meeting at the City Hall, 8838 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; the L.A. County Library, Rosemead Branch, 8800 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; and other locations pursuant to RMC Sec. 1.08.020. Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the Rosemead Public Safety Commission regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
